description: Department of Census and Statistics - The Colombo Consumers' Price Index for the Month of October, 2015 was 182.1
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the Colombo Consumers' Price Index for October 2015, which is statistical economic data published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters). This falls under general administrative/statistical announcements that don't fit the other defined categories.
